<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/contests/{id}/leaderboard/{user_id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Reads the contest's unfiltered standings, at any rank. A participant's rank is one more than the number of participants with a higher score, and `is_tie` reports that another participant has the same score. Every registered participant is ranked, with a score of 0 before their first log.
